info.name: ION Starter Kit Seller App
info.description: ION seller and discovery-service requests generated from release flow examples.

request.description: Storefront publish_catalog — BPP publishes a physical goods catalog. Example: Domino's Pizza Sudirman publishing a large pepperoni pizza.
Storefront on_discover — ION Discovery Service returns the matching Domino's Pizza Sudirman catalog.
Storefront on_select — BPP returns quote with price breakdown and SLA.

Storefront on_init — BPP returns QRIS payment string and final quote. On the payment settlement the BPP sets the settlement terms (due one day after delivery), computes the finder fee amount from its final price, restates the figures, and adds its payout account next to the BAP's; the PJP holds the payment and pays both after reconciliation.
B2C-SF on_confirm — BPP confirms a food QSR order. Beckn v2.0 Contract shape.
Storefront on_status DELIVERED — package delivered. Contract transitions to COMPLETE.
Storefront on_status DISPATCHED — BPP returns the current state after the status poll; package picked up, with AWB and tracking URL.
Storefront on_status OUT_FOR_DELIVERY — delivery agent en route.
Storefront on_status PACKED — order packed, ready for logistics pickup.
Storefront on_track — BPP returns an active real-time tracking handle for the confirmed pizza order.
Storefront on_rate — BPP confirms the 4-out-of-5 resource rating was recorded.
Storefront on_cancel preview — BPP returns the projected free full-cancellation outcome before packing without persisting it.
Storefront on_cancel — BPP confirms the free cancellation committed before packing or shipment.
Storefront on_update preview — BPP returns the previewed contract with revised buyer delivery instructions without persisting the change.
Storefront on_update — BPP confirms the buyer delivery instruction changes have been committed to the contract.
Storefront grievance — the BPP acknowledges the grievance; as the direct callback of support_OPENED it repeats that request's messageId.
Storefront grievance — the BPP has refunded 30000 through the settlement flow (settlement PAY-RFD-2026-00004400) and reports the refund reference.
Storefront grievance — after checking with the store, the BPP proposes version 1: a partial refund of 30000 on line L01, borne by the BPP, which needs the BAP's explicit acceptance.

Storefront grievance — every action is executed, so the BPP reports the grievance RESOLVED with the full record. Without an objection within the grievance SLA policy's objection period, both participants treat it as closed; the 30000 refund is still agreed in reconcile.
Storefront on_reconcile — the BAP agrees with the BPP's figures. Both participants have agreed, so SEAM instructs the PJP to pay 96120 to the BPP and 2670 to the BAP.
